description: At a sunny outdoor flea market, a young woman with long braids, in a brown t-shirt and jeans, holds up an ugly shiny green-gold china poodle holding a bunch of plastic grapes and pulls a disgusted face. She turns to look at it, grimaces again and then bursts out laughing. Beside her a young woman with red hair holds a lamp with a pink fringed shade, and an older man in a flat cap smiles behind the stall. The table is covered in teacups, brass ornaments and records under striped awnings and bunting.

taps.phrase: to hold up a china poodle

taps.target: the man in the flat cap
